cases.situation: I just got into a PhD program in Edinburgh, starting in January, so I'm moving from Toronto. My best friend Zoe and I have lived 10 minutes apart for 8 years. I want to tell her before I post anything.
cases.reply: Wanted you to hear this from me before it's anywhere else: I got into the PhD in Edinburgh! It starts in January, so I'm moving over Christmas. I'm thrilled and also already missing you. Can I take you for dinner Friday and tell you everything?
cases.note: Closest people first, individually. The news, one line of feeling, what's next.

cases.situation: 我和老公决定离婚了，已经协商好。想在大学室友的四人群里说一声，免得她们以后问起尴尬，但不想被追问细节。
cases.reply: 跟你们说件事，统一说一次就不再重复啦：我和阿杰决定离婚了，已经好好谈过，是和平分开的。我还好，就是需要点时间适应。不想聊原因，但很想这阵子多见见你们，下个月谁有空一起吃个饭？
cases.note: 群里说一次，直接告诉大家怎么回应：不问细节，要陪伴。

cases.situation: I'm pregnant (due in April) and want to tell my close friend Hana, who's been doing IVF for two years. I don't want her to find out from the group chat.
cases.reply: I wanted to tell you this one directly and quietly, because I know it's not simple for you right now: I'm pregnant, due in April. You don't have to say anything, and you don't have to be anything but honest with me about how it lands. I love you, and I'll tell the group next week.
cases.note: For news that may hurt the reader, a separate gentle message first, with explicit permission not to respond.

cases.situation: I'm leaving my accounting job at Deloitte on Oct 30 to run my bakery full time. My parents sacrificed a lot for my degree and they'll worry. We have our usual call Sunday but I want to text first so it's not an ambush.
cases.reply: Mom, Dad, I want to tell you something before our call on Sunday so you have time to take it in: I'm leaving Deloitte on October 30 to run the bakery full time. I've saved eight months of expenses and the Saturday market stall already covers its own costs. I know how much you gave for that degree, and I'll be using every bit of it on my own business. On Sunday I'd love your questions, and I'd love it if we could start from being happy for me.
cases.note: News likely to worry the reader: lead with the fact, give the two numbers that answer the first fear, and say how you hope they'll respond.

cases.situation: 我刚拿到一家大厂的offer，11月2号入职。最好的朋友小雨上个月刚被裁，还在找工作。想单独先告诉她，不想让她从朋友圈看到。
cases.reply: 雨，想先单独跟你说一声，不想你从朋友圈看到：我拿到了新offer，11月2号入职。我知道你这阵子找工作很累，所以想自己先告诉你，你不用急着回，也不用勉强说恭喜。周六我请你吃饭吧，想听听你那边怎么样，不聊我的事也完全可以。
cases.note: 好消息遇上处境难的读者：单独先说，简短，不铺陈细节，并明确告诉她不用做出反应。

cases.situation: I've been diagnosed with breast cancer, caught early. Surgery is Oct 14 and I'll be off about six weeks. My manager knows; I want to email my team of 5 myself but I don't want lots of questions.
cases.reply: Hi all, I wanted you to hear this from me: I've been diagnosed with breast cancer. It was caught early and the outlook is good. I'm having surgery on Wednesday, Oct 14, and will be off for about six weeks; Rohan is covering my projects and has everything he needs. I'd rather not go into details, but kind messages are very welcome and you don't need to find the perfect words. I'll send a short note when I'm back.
cases.note: Hard news at work: the fact, the practical plan, and a clear signal for how to respond.
